resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Four of 8 hidden ReLUs always active on train (affine relays); 3196 clips on only 3 rows; the ca=3 dip rests on 12 train rows. Nine unconnected inputs as root entries.
vs_40gen: Kept 1173, 2245, 1801; dropped 664 (ca/slope:2 gate) and 2009 (thalach chain). 1801 gained thalach, a negative ca term and an oldpeak hinge; the ca relay grew into a deeper chain with an age-dependent high-ca detector making the ca effect non-monotone. Train AUC 0.939 -> 0.951.
summary: Mostly logistic regression (15 direct edges, logit SD 3.31 of 3.74; all hidden mean-ablated: AUC 0.951 -> 0.923). Main nonlinearity: normal_ecg_st_gate adds risk only with normal resting ECG and low ca. Second: ca_age_saturation, a ca pathway with a detector subtracting for ca=3 and younger ca=2, making ca's effect non-monotone.
